archival_memory.user_introduction: I'm a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Seattle. I'm interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit my design aesthetic.
archival_memory.user_message: I'm reaching out under some pretty unfortunate circumstances today. I finally received my package, but when I opened it up, I found that the machine appears to be damaged. So I'm hoping we can sort this out and figure out the best next steps for a replacement or repair.
archival_memory.user_details: The outer box had seven crushed corners, and the top was slightly caved in. The espresso machine's stainless-steel body on the right side has a significant dent and sharp edges. It looks like the machine was hit from the side with something.
